name: Ash Raider
description: A Mutagen raider of the Void Nomads, from the clans the ash wastes hardened and Zenith drove from their camps.
role: The common hostile of the frontier: raiders attack on sight and drop what they took.
voice: Clipped clan slang, threats and old grievances against Zenith.

greeting.text: Zenith burned our camps. Now we burn their roads. You on their road?
